title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Organize Liquidation of a Private School Terminated Due to Insolvency and Inability to Continue Operation

articles.content_en:
Amended by the Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Amending
the Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether State-Allocated Land Use Rights of Bankrupt Enterprises Shall Be Included in Bankruptcy Property and Other Matters and Twenty-Nine Other Commercial Judicial Interpretations, adopted at the 1823rd Meeting of the Adjudication Committee)
Higher People's Court of Guizhou Province:
The Request for Instructions from Your Court on How the People's Court Shall Accept an "Organized Liquidation" After Zunyi County Zhongshan Middle School Is Terminated [(2010) Qian Gao Yan Qing Zi No. 1] has been received. Upon deliberation, the reply is as follows:
Where a privately-run school established upon approval in accordance with Article 10 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Promotion of Privately-Run Schools is terminated because it is unable to continue operating due to insolvency, and a party applies to the People's Court for liquidation in accordance with Article 58, Paragraph 2 of the said Law, the People's Court shall accept the case according to law. Where the People's Court organizes bankruptcy liquidation of a privately-run school, the procedures prescribed by the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China shall apply mutatis mutandis, and the debts shall be paid in accordance with the order prescribed by Article 59 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Promotion of Privately-Run Schools.
